test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelled word that means "excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters."

The ____ neighbor kept everyone awake with his endless stories.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. garrulous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **garrulous** means excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters.
 
• From the options provided, **option 3** is the correctly spelled word that fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The other options are misspelled and do not correspond to the correct spelling of the word.

Correct sentence: *The garrulous neighbor kept everyone awake with his endless stories.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Definition:** Garrulous is derived from the Latin word *garrulus*, meaning talkative.
 
• **Usage in context:** It is often used to describe someone whose excessive talking can be annoying or disruptive.
